name: Short the perp three days before a large insider unlock, long BTC, close at the unlock
thesis: Holders of a scheduled insider or investor cliff cannot sell before it unlocks but can hedge by shorting the perp, so the token weakens into the date and rebounds after delivery. Out of sample (2026-04 to 2026-10, 84 cliffs of at least 1% of unlocked supply) the coin fell 2.5% against BTC in the three days before and the trade made +1.98% after costs against a placebo of -0.34% (excess t 2.04, event-day t 2.18). It was not the protocol’s pre-registered pick (the symmetric window, which failed out of sample), and the latest quarter was negative, so it carries go=no until a forward test.
mechanism: Unlock recipients short the Hyperliquid or CEX perp ahead of T and deliver tokens into those shorts after T; the perp funding does not charge for it over three days (a short received about zero), while a fourteen-day window paid 0.39%. Out of sample the three days after the unlock reversed by about 1% (event-day t -2.16), the other half of the same footprint.
legs: at T-3d sell the coin perp on Hyperliquid, sized to the bids within 25bp
buy the same notional of the BTC perp
close both at the unlock time T
kill_criteria: after 30 forward events (unlock_study.py upcoming lists them), mean excess over the placebo not positive
promote to go only if the forward excess is positive at an event-day t above 2
median bid depth within 25bp on the event coins below $15k (the round trip then eats the edge)
risks: chosen after seeing the out-of-sample table: the pre-registered symmetric window failed (+0.73%, t 0.59)
the most recent full quarter (2026Q3) was -0.59% against its placebo: the effect may be decaying as it is traded
DefiLlama dates are modelled schedules, not on-chain deliveries; teams delay, re-lock or sell OTC
thin books: median $38k of bids within 25bp and a 35bp round trip at $100k; capacity is per-event and small
a short squeeze into the unlock (if the market is net short already) is the tail

evidence.notes: research/2026-10-09/unlocks/findings.md; analysis.json sellers.variants window [-3,0] min_size 0.01 (by_quarter, placebo, t_out_by_day); scripts/unlock_study.py (collect, prices, analyze, upcoming)

quotes.note: out of sample +1.98% a trade over 3 days after costs (84 events, ~161 a year at >=1%); at ~$38k a trade that is ~$120k a year on ~$50k average deployed notional; go=no pending a 30-event forward test
